name: Zebecke (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of blue over green with a light grey triangle at the hoist whose point reaches the fly, charged in the triangle with the municipal arms of Zebecke (a blue and green shield with a bough, within a wreath) below the name ZEBECKE.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
